features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You gain darkvision 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet. From 13th level, you can see through magical darkness too.

features.name: Marked for Death
features.description: If a melee weapon attack against a creature you have marked deals more damage than its remaining hit points, it drops to 0 hit points.

features.name: Undead Empathy
features.description: An Undead that targets you with an attack must first make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier); on a failure the attack misses, and if its Intelligence is 4 or less it is friendly to you and your allies for 1 minute.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Gravelord
features.description: Once per long rest, as an action, take on undeath for 1 minute: immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition; Undying usable three times per long rest instead of once; and once per turn, when your melee weapon attack damages a hostile creature, add 4d6 necrotic damage and gain that much temporary hit points until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You learn two druid cantrips (a third at 10th level) and know three 1st-level druid spells, two of which must be evocation or transmutation. Later spells must be evocation or transmutation except those gained at 8th, 14th, and 20th level, which can be any school; you can swap one known spell per warden level under the same rule. Slots return on a long rest; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier; attack modifier proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier). Spells known: 3 at 3rd, 4 at 4th-6th, 5 at 7th, 6 at 8th-9th, 7 at 10th, 8 at 11th-12th, 9 at 13th, 10 at 14th-15th, 11 at 16th-18th, 12 at 19th, 13 at 20th. Slots (1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 2 at 3rd; 3 at 4th-6th; 4/2 at 7th-9th; 4/3 at 10th-12th; 4/3/2 at 13th-15th; 4/3/3 at 16th-18th; 4/3/3/1 at 19th-20th.

features.name: Soulblood
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, you can mark it as a reaction.

features.name: Whispers of Beyond
features.description: Spend 1 minute in contemplation when making an Intelligence or Wisdom check to gain advantage, provided your ancestors could plausibly know the answer.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

features.name: Ethereal Watcher
features.description: Once per long rest, as an action, become spirit-like for 1 minute: as a bonus action you can turn ethereal as per etherealness; you can use your bonus action to return when you use Warden's Mark or Warden's Grasp, or when you cast a spell on your turn; on returning, creatures you choose within 10 feet take 4d6 force damage; and you can cast your known 1st- and 2nd-level druid spells without spending slots.

features.name: Roots of Rock
features.description: Using Warden's Grasp gives you +2 AC until the start of your next turn. Also, until you move, hostile effects can't shove or push you unless you allow it, you have advantage on Strength saves against being knocked prone, you can't slip or fall from ledges, and you are immune to fly, levitate, and telekinesis.

features.name: Earthshatter
features.description: You can use Warden's Grasp as an action instead; each affected creature must pass a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier) or fall prone. Uses equal your Strength modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

features.name: Mettle
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Constitution save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Immortal Mountain
features.description: Once per long rest, as an action, encase yourself in stone for 1 minute: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage you take is reduced by 5, Roots of Rock applies the whole time, and you can leave a 5-foot-wide trail of difficult terrain as you move.

features.name: Thunderblast
features.description: When you hit a creature you have marked with a melee weapon attack, creatures you choose within 5 feet of it take 1d8 lightning damage.

features.name: Flash from Above
features.description: While under open sky, you can use an action to produce a harmless but dramatic lightning bolt or thunderclap, even without clouds.

features.name: Static Burst
features.description: When you use Warden's Grasp as a bonus action, affected creatures can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Stormlord
features.description: You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. Once per long rest, as an action, call lightning onto yourself for 1 minute: your flying speed doubles, and you can cast call lightning as a bonus action without a slot (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier), calling later bolts as a bonus action.

features.name: Green Mark
features.description: While a creature you have marked is within 30 feet of you, the ground it moves across is difficult terrain.

features.name: Verdant Skin
features.description: You gain Stealth proficiency if you lack it. As an action, wrap yourself in vines and leaves; until you move, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in vegetation.

features.name: Mettle
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Constitution save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Form of the Oak Sentinel
features.description: Once per long rest, as an action, transform for 1 minute: your AC becomes 20 if lower, your melee attacks have 10-foot reach, and you can use Warden's Grasp as an action to make a separate attack against each affected creature.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You gain Intelligence-based slot spellcasting from the wizard spell list; slots return on a long rest. You start knowing three 1st-level wizard spells, two of which must be conjuration or evocation, and every later spell must be conjuration or evocation except the ones gained at 8th, 14th, and 20th level. Each warmage level you may swap one known wizard spell for another of a level you have slots for (subject to the same school limit). By warmage level (spells known, slots 1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 3: 3 known, slots 2; 4: 4 known, slots 3; 5: 4 known, slots 3; 6: 4 known, slots 3; 7: 5 known, slots 4/2; 8: 6 known, slots 4/2; 9: 6 known, slots 4/2; 10: 7 known, slots 4/3; 11: 8 known, slots 4/3; 12: 8 known, slots 4/3; 13: 9 known, slots 4/3/2; 14: 10 known, slots 4/3/2; 15: 10 known, slots 4/3/2; 16: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 17: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 18: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 19: 12 known, slots 4/3/3/1; 20: 13 known, slots 4/3/3/1. Warmage Edge applies to your leveled warmage spells as if they were cantrips, except magic missile.

features.name: Arcane Study
features.description: Gain proficiency in two of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, or Religion.

features.name: Mystical Companion
features.description: You learn find familiar as a ritual, free of your spells known, and can pick an imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite form in addition to the usual forms.

features.name: Siege Casting
features.description: Your warmage spells deal double damage to objects and structures. Spells of yours that use a spell attack can reach up to twice their normal range, with disadvantage on the attack beyond normal range.

features.name: Spell Sculpting
features.description: When your warmage spell affects creatures you can see, choose up to your Intelligence modifier of them: they automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage where a success would normally halve it.

features.name: Arcane Dominance
features.description: As a bonus action, spend spell slots totaling 6 or more levels to recover one expended use of Arcane Surge.

features.name: Bluff
features.description: Gain proficiency in Deception and the playing card set (if you lack them), and you can use Intelligence instead of Charisma for Charisma (Deception) checks.

features.name: Deck of Fate
features.description: When you roll initiative, shuffle a standard 52-card deck and draw five. When you target a hostile creature with a damaging warmage spell, you can spend your bonus action to play cards from your hand; if they form an exact hand from the table, one chosen target takes extra damage or you gain an effect (aces count as 1). Hands: Straight (any five in sequence) +12 damage; Flush (five of one suit) +10 damage; Three of a Kind +6 damage; Pair +2 damage; two Hearts, temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier; two Spades, +10 feet speed until the start of your next turn; two Diamonds, +1 AC until the start of your next turn; two Clubs, +1 to saving throws until the start of your next turn. Played cards go to the bottom of the deck and you draw back up to five. Unmatched cards do nothing.

features.name: High Stakes
features.description: On your turn, with no action, put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of the deck, losing 2 hit points per card, then draw back up to five.

features.name: Dealer's Choice
features.description: As a bonus action, gain one effect that the GM picks: resistance to all damage until the end of your next turn; teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet; or vanish into a safe demiplane until the start of your next turn, returning to the spot you left. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Card Reading
features.description: Once per turn when you draw for Deck of Fate, name a suit and look at the top card; if you named it correctly, you can also take the Dash, Disengage, or Use an Object action as part of that bonus action.

features.name: Ace in the Hole
features.description: Whenever you draw cards, draw twice as many, put half on the bottom of the deck, and keep the rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency in Sleight of Hand and the dice set if you lack them.

features.name: Dice of Fate
features.description: You have four Dice of Fate (d6s). Spend one to add it to an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or damage roll; spent dice pass to the GM, who can add one to an NPC or monster roll, after which it returns to you. A long rest restores all your dice whether or not the GM used them. At 7th level you gain two more dice and can add two Dice of Fate to damage rolls of your warmage spells.

features.name: Chaos Roll
features.description: As an action, spend two Dice of Fate and roll them (2d6): 2, you cast fireball centered on yourself; 3, your AC drops by 2 until the start of your next turn; 4, you fall prone; 5, every other creature within 60 feet can only babble for 1 minute and can't supply verbal components; 6, a 5-foot-radius sphere of butterflies, insects, or doves heavily obscures a point within 60 feet until the start of your next turn; 7, gain 7 temporary hit points and keep both dice instead of giving them to the GM; 8, you turn invisible (as invisibility) until the end of your next turn; 9, a random object within 60 feet explodes, dealing 3d6 fire damage to one creature the GM chooses and none to you or allies; 10, teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see, and each creature within 5 feet of the destination makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 force damage; 11, a creature you can see within 60 feet takes 4d6 necrotic damage and you heal that much; 12, you cast lightning bolt and may add Dice of Fate to its damage.

features.name: Loaded Dice
features.description: Once per turn when you roll a d6, you can turn it over so the opposite face (7 minus the result) counts instead.

features.name: Twisted Fate
features.description: When you make an attack roll or ability check with disadvantage on your turn, you can use a bonus action to spend and roll a Die of Fate: on a 5 you ignore the disadvantage, and on a 6 you have advantage instead.

features.name: Roll the Bones
features.description: When a creature you can see damages you, you can use your reaction and spend two Dice of Fate to make a Chaos Roll.

features.name: Steal Luck
features.description: When you roll initiative, roll a d6 and reclaim that many Dice of Fate from the GM.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor, battleaxes, lances, longswords, tridents, and warhammers.

features.name: Battle Tactics
features.description: You fuel stratagems with battle dice: 2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 7th, 3d10 at 13th, and 4d10 at 19th. All spent dice return on a short or long rest or when you roll initiative. You can use one stratagem per turn, and stratagem saves use your spell save DC. Stratagems: Blitz (bonus action after hitting with an attack; an ally who can see or hear you can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from your target); Check (bonus action after a hit; the target makes a Charisma save, auto-success if immune to charm, or must use its reaction to move up to half its speed directly away from you); Flash of Brilliance (add the die to an Intelligence or Wisdom check, even after rolling but before the result is known); Gambit (after a hit, the next creature other than you to attack the target adds the die to its attack roll); Mystic Counsel (bonus action, a creature within 30 feet that can hear you can add the die to one save against a spell in the next minute); Stalemate (bonus action after a hit; until the end of its next turn the target can't move willingly unless it first Disengages).

features.name: Lead from the Front
features.description: You and allies within 120 feet who can see you ignore nonmagical difficult terrain.

features.name: Tactical Master
features.description: Friendly creatures within 10 feet of you add your Intelligence modifier to saves against damaging spells and magical effects.

features.name: Stratagem: Checkmate
features.description: New stratagem: after hitting with a weapon or spell attack, use a bonus action and a battle die so an ally who can see or hear you and is within reach of the target can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack or cast an attack-roll cantrip, adding the die to that attack's damage.

features.name: Grandmaster
features.description: When you roll initiative, up to your Intelligence modifier of allies who can see or hear you each get a free battle die (no expenditure). Once within 10 minutes, each can add it to an ability check, attack roll, damage roll, or save, deciding after the roll but before the outcome is declared. A creature can hold only one such die at a time.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor and martial weapons.

features.name: Force Breastplate
features.description: While in light or medium armor or under mage armor, you use your Intelligence modifier in place of Dexterity for your AC.

features.name: Mystical Weapon
features.description: You learn force weapon as a bonus cantrip. Whenever you would draw a weapon on your turn, you can instead conjure any simple or martial weapon of force into an empty hand; it counts as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity and disappears if it leaves your hand.

features.name: Flurry of Blades
features.description: When you cast a cantrip that makes multiple spell attacks (such as force weapon or magic daggers), you can use your bonus action to make one more attack with it.

features.name: Knight's Ward
features.description: As a bonus action, gain temporary hit points equal to twice your warmage level for 1 minute. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Tactical Maneuver
features.description: You can spend all of your movement to teleport up to half your speed to an unoccupied space you can see.

features.name: Field of Blades
features.description: As an action, make separate melee spell attacks against up to five creatures you can see within 30 feet; each hit deals 2d10 + your Intelligence modifier force damage.

features.name: Intercept Technique
features.description: With no armor and no shield, your AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier + Intelligence modifier; under mage armor it is 13 + your choice of Dexterity or Intelligence modifier. Using a shield removes this benefit.

features.name: Hand-to-Hand Arcana
features.description: Your unarmed strikes can use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls, can deal 1d6 in place of their normal damage, and count as melee weapons for warmage spells.

features.name: Shock Trooper
features.description: When you make a melee attack on your turn against a creature you can see, you can first lunge up to 15 feet toward it without provoking opportunity attacks, even through the air (you fall after the attack if not on solid ground).

features.name: Mystical Physicality
features.description: You can use your Intelligence modifier for Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks, and difficult terrain costs you no extra movement.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.description: When a ranged spell attack or ranged weapon attack dealing cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, or radiant damage hits you, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Intelligence modifier + half your warmage level (rounded down).

features.name: Improved Shock Trooper
features.description: Your Shock Trooper lunge reaches 30 feet and becomes a teleport that passes through creatures and objects, though you can't end in an occupied space.

features.name: Flurry of Spells
features.description: As an action, spend an Arcane Surge use to cast three different cantrips that each take 1 action or 1 bonus action; Arcane Surge can't apply to them. Once per long rest.

features.name: Promotion
features.description: Learn one extra warmage trick that doesn't count against tricks known. Whenever you learn a trick, you can pick ones requiring the House of Bishops, Kings, Knights, or Rooks, provided you meet their other prerequisites.

features.name: Adaptive Arcanist
features.description: After each short or long rest, pick a warmage cantrip; you know it (not counted against cantrips known) until you pick another with this feature.

features.name: Pawn Storm
features.description: A creature you target with a cantrip can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of the turn, whether or not the cantrip damaged it.

features.name: Additional Arcane Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a second option from Arcane Fighting Style.

features.name: Opening Move
features.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to initiative, and when you roll initiative while not surprised you can move up to your speed.

features.name: Fundamental Mastery
features.description: Once per turn when rolling damage for a warmage cantrip, treat one damage die as its maximum result.

features.name: Rook Strike
features.description: As a bonus action, gain advantage on your next spell attack roll this turn, or give a creature disadvantage on its save against a warmage spell you cast before your turn ends. Recharges on a short or long rest, or when a cantrip of yours drops a creature to 0 hit points.

features.name: Rasp
features.description: You can cast knock at will without a spell slot; cast this way it takes 1 minute and makes no sound.

features.name: Arcane Acrobat
features.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to every Dexterity check, and when you fall while not incapacitated you can reduce the fall by up to 60 feet for damage purposes.

features.name: Fleeting Decoy
features.description: When a creature you can see damages you, you can use your reaction so attacks against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Elusive Step
features.description: Once you have moved more than 15 feet on your turn, your further movement that turn doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

features.name: Flash of Feathers
features.description: Cast invisibility on yourself only, with no slot or components. While invisible this way your speed doubles, and you can make one attack or cast one warmage cantrip without ending the invisibility. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Black Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st exhume, inflict wounds; 2nd gentle repose, magic weapon; 3rd animate dead, vampiric touch; 4th blight, death ward; 5th cloudkill, contagion.

features.name: Hex: Decay
features.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure at the start of its next turn it suffers 1d4 necrotic damage and its hit point maximum drops by that amount while the hex lasts, killing it if the maximum reaches 0. Ends at the end of your next turn.

features.name: Undeath Command
features.description: The bonus action you use to command your familiar can also command any Undead you control through animate dead or similar magic.

features.name: Life Tether
features.description: When a creature you can see damages you, you can use your reaction to split the damage with the sole target of your hex: you take half (rounded down) and it takes the rest. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Black Sacrifice
features.description: As an action with your familiar within 10 feet, you sacrifice its bond: creatures you choose within 20 feet of it make a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking 8d10 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success, and their hit point maximum drops by the necrotic damage taken (dying at 0). The familiar can't be summoned again before your next long rest.

features.name: Blood Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st hellish rebuke, hollowing curse; 2nd acid arrow, hold person; 3rd ruby-eye curse, vampiric touch; 4th blight, dominate beast; 5th cloudkill, dominate person.

features.name: Hex: Blood Curse
features.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure, until the end of your next turn, the moment it is both injured and under twice your witch level in hit points, it falls to 0 hit points.

features.name: Novice Hemomancy
features.description: A drop of your blood can replace material components that have no listed cost.

features.name: Arcane Bloodletting
features.description: When casting a spell with a casting time of 1 action, lose 5 hit points to cast it as a bonus action instead. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

features.name: Deathseeker
features.description: You sense the location of any creature within 60 feet that is missing hit points, even when heavily obscured and through most barriers (stopped by a foot of stone, an inch of ordinary metal, a thin lead sheet, or 3 feet of wood or earth). You have advantage on checks to track a creature you or your familiar damaged in the last 24 hours.

features.name: Hemomantic Recovery
features.description: Once per day after a short rest, spend Hit Dice to regain spell slots of 5th level or lower: 2 Hit Dice for 1st, 3 for 2nd, 5 for 3rd, 6 for 4th, 7 for 5th.

features.name: Sanguine
features.description: Once per round, when your spell hurts a hostile creature that is your hex's only target, you can lose hit points to add 2d8 necrotic damage per 5 hit points lost, up to 6d8.

features.name: Green Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st entangle, goodberry; 2nd barkskin, locate animals or plants; 3rd conjure animals, plant growth; 4th conjure woodland beings, stoneskin; 5th awaken, tree stride.

features.name: Hex: Elder Tongue
features.description: As a bonus action, until the end of your next turn you can communicate in a limited way with Beasts and Plants (they can relay simple recent observations) and have advantage on Charisma checks to influence them.

features.name: Primal Ally
features.description: Your familiar adds three times your witch level to its hit point maximum instead of twice.

features.name: Twin Familiar
features.description: When summoned, your familiar can be split into two identical bodies sharing one hit point pool, acting on consecutive turns. Command one to attack with your bonus action and the other with your action; effects that target or dismiss the familiar affect both.

features.name: Vital Nourishment
features.description: When you finish a long rest, plants within 120 feet grow as if a month of ideal conditions passed, and food-bearing plants yield enough to feed six creatures for a day. Up to six creatures you can see gain temporary hit points of half your witch level + Charisma modifier, and you can end one disease or one blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned condition on each.

features.name: Sacrificial Familiar
features.description: When a melee attack targets you with your familiar within 5 feet, you can use your reaction to have the attack target the familiar instead. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

features.name: Purple Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st charm person, silent image; 2nd enthrall, invisibility; 3rd hypnotic pattern, major image; 4th confusion, private sanctum; 5th modify memory, seeming.

features.name: Hex: Hallucination
features.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save (auto-success if immune to charm); on a failure it takes -1 to attack rolls and ability checks, worsening by 1 at the start of each of its turns to a maximum of -5. Lasts until the end of your next turn.

features.name: False Authority
features.description: As an action, everyone who sees you perceives you as an authority figure relevant to them for 1 hour (or until you end it); it doesn't survive physical inspection, and a creature can use its action and an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through it. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Deceitful Transposition
features.description: As a bonus action, make two creatures within 60 feet appear to have swapped places, relocating their sounds, smells, and other cues; they don't perceive the illusion. An observer can use its action and an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see the truth. Lasts 1 minute, ending early if either takes damage or a physical interaction exposes it. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Waking Nightmare
features.description: When a creature fails its save against your Hallucination hex, you can make it treat every creature as an enemy until the hex ends: it picks targets for attacks, spells, and effects at random among creatures in range it can see, and must use its reaction on any opportunity attack offered. Ends after 1 minute. Once per long rest.

features.name: Red Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st burning hands, magic missile; 2nd acid arrow, scorching ray; 3rd fireball, protection from energy; 4th ice storm, wall of fire; 5th cone of cold, telekinesis.

features.name: Hex: Imperil
features.description: Action, choose a damage type and one creature you can see within 60 feet, which makes a Constitution save; on a failure its resistance to that type is suppressed through the end of your next turn, and immunity to it is downgraded to resistance.

features.name: Convolute Energy
features.description: Casting a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage can grant you resistance to that damage type through the end of your next turn.

features.name: Invulnerability
features.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 50. Once per long rest.

features.name: Elemental Annihilation
features.description: When you cast a witch spell dealing acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can spend an additional slot of equal or higher level to deal maximum damage. Once per long rest.

features.name: Steel Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st heroism, shield; 2nd heat metal, magic weapon; 3rd blink, haste; 4th death ward, freedom of movement; 5th flame strike, telekinesis.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial melee weapons that lack the heavy and special properties.

features.name: Hex: Malevolence
features.description: As a bonus action, wrap yourself in evil smog until the end of your next turn; damage can't break your concentration on it. While active: AC 12 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier without a shield (usable if better than your armor); use Charisma for attack and damage with melee weapons lacking heavy and special; and a visible creature within 5 feet that damages you can be answered with a melee weapon attack as your reaction.

features.name: Cackling Killer
features.description: On a turn you use Cackle, you attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Soulsword Familiar
features.description: As a bonus action, dismiss your familiar into your weapon, wreathing it in green flame; it deals an extra 1d8 fire damage on a hit until you resummon the familiar, which you can't do until a short or long rest.

features.name: Shrieking Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack, the target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is frightened of you for up to 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

features.name: Tea Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st hideous laughter, sanctuary; 2nd augury, calm emotions; 3rd clairvoyance, sending; 4th divination, private sanctum; 5th legend lore, scrying.

features.name: Hex: Tasseography
features.description: Action, pick an ally you can see within 60 feet and roll a d20, noting the result. Until the end of your next turn you can substitute that number for one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check the ally makes, chosen before it rolls; the hex then ends.

features.name: Tea Ceremony
features.description: During a short or long rest you conjure tea for yourself and allies; each creature that drinks it removes one extra level of exhaustion during that rest.

features.name: Shapes and Omens
features.description: After a long rest, the GM describes a shape in your tea leaves that hints at upcoming events.

features.name: Herbal Remedy
features.description: Cast greater restoration without a slot or material components. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Invigorate
features.description: As a bonus action, you or an ally you can see within 5 feet gains one extra action on its next turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Technicolor Magic Spells
features.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st color spray, speak with animals; 2nd animal messenger, warding bond; 3rd fly, sending; 4th freedom of movement, locate creature; 5th telepathic bond, teleportation circle.

features.name: Hex: Musical Interlude
features.description: Action, each willing creature within 30 feet that you can see and that can see you gains temporary hit points of half your witch level + Charisma modifier, lasting through the end of your next turn.

features.name: Animal Friends
features.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks to befriend Beasts, using Charisma instead of Wisdom for Small or smaller ones. You can dismiss an adopted Beast pet into an extradimensional space as you would a familiar.

features.name: Friendship Bracelet
features.description: As an action, craft a cheap bracelet. You always know the location of a creature wearing one while on the same plane and can aim spells and effects at it without needing sight of it.

features.name: Positivity
features.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, your reaction adds to your AC one point per friendly creature within 5 feet of you, possibly causing a miss. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Redemptive Arc
